location_description: Rotterdam is a town in Schenectady County, New York, United States. The population was 30,523 at the 2020 census.The town of Rotterdam is in the south-central part of the county. It was founded by Dutch settlers, who named it after the city of Rotterdam in the Netherlands, where many immigrants last touched European grounds.
